lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a column-and-row formation along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient consisting of a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than the blobs on the primary flank.
